sense.text:
Paul marvels that they are “so soon removed from him that called you into the grace of Christ unto another gospel”. In context, in the time of the Apostle Paul you had Israelites who were leaving off keeping the commandments in Christ and joining the traditions of the scribes and Pharisees, keeping animal sacrifice. That is what was going on.

Nobody is doing animal sacrifice today, so how does this come up now? For the past few centuries we have been following white Jesus, which is non-Biblical. Following traditions of men, which is non-Biblical. And not keeping the commandments in Christ — Black Christ.

Now we have awoken to the truth that we are Israelites, and we are teaching our people to keep the commandments in the faith of Christ, Black Christ. That is the gospel men are being removed from again.

“Which is not another” — because the same scriptures Paul and the apostles were teaching from Genesis to Malachi, also including the Apocrypha, they had back then. The scribes and Pharisees were using those same scriptures to try to manipulate people and keep them under animal sacrifice and traditions.

“But there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.” They were perverting the gospel of Christ, saying no, no, no, Christ didn't come, the Messiah has not come, stay under animal sacrifice.

Now there are men and women coming around saying go back to white Jesus, go back to the traditions we learned during the time of slavery, go back to the lies we learned under colonialism. And some of our brothers, some of our sisters have gone back to worshipping a non-Biblical white Jesus, keeping traditions and lies.

“But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.”

So it is not wrong when we say our people that are out teaching that they are accursed. That is what the Bible says. It says, let him be accursed.

“As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.” Paul says it a second time.

If they are not teaching that Christ is a black man of the tribe of Judah that died for the black and brown 12 tribes of Israel, and that we must keep the commandments, let him be accursed.

“For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.”

So if we seek to please men, to be a man pleaser, we would not be the servants of Christ.
“But I certify you, brethren, that the gospel which was preached of me is not after man.” The gospel Paul preached is not after man.

“For I neither received it of man, neither was I taught it, but by the revelation of Jesus Christ.”

Christ taught Paul personally. Peter did not teach him. James did not teach him. None of the apostles taught Paul. Christ himself taught Paul.

precepts.why:
Start at verse 19 to get the setting: “Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.” The gospel initially was only taught to the kingdom of Judah first. That was the kingdom of Judah.

Then verse 26: “And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.” So the people started to call the disciples, the Jews, Christians, meaning the anointed ones. That is what Christian means, the anointed ones. That is what the people started to call the Jews that followed Christ.

So when did our people start being called Catholic? Ignatius of Antioch was the first to refer to them as Catholics, and the word Catholic means universal. That is way after the death of the apostles. The name began as what the people called the Jews who followed Christ, and it was taken over by something else entirely.

Ezra gives the timing: “For my son Jesus shall be revealed with those that be with him, and they that remain shall rejoice within four hundred years.” Four hundred years from the time of Esdras the disciples rejoiced when Christ came — the disciples that were alive in the first century rejoiced when Christ came.

“After these years shall my son Christ die, and all men that have life.” After those years Christ was sacrificed, crucified on the cross. And after Christ died and was resurrected, all men that have life died — meaning all the disciples were killed, murdered, assassinated by Rome. All of them.

“And the world shall be turned into the old silence seven days, like as in the former judgments: so that no man shall remain.” No truth was going to be taught. No man of God was around teaching keep the commandments in the faith of Christ, gather the 12 tribes. Nobody was teaching that. What they called the Dark Ages is that silent era. And it was in that silence, around 325 Anno Domini, that the Catholic Church was initiated under Constantine and his mother Helena. Many of the original pictures of Constantine and his mama were black — they were evil black men and women, and that is why it was called the dark ages: not because people were unlearned, but because dark people were ruling.

“Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ.” That is the warning against man-made religion.

Look at what came out of the Protestant Reformation, which began in 1517 when Martin Luther posted his 95 Theses on the door of the Castle Church in Wittenberg — October 31st, Halloween. John Smith created the Baptist religion in 1608. Joseph Smith created the Mormon religion in 1830. Ellen G. White created the Seventh-day Adventist religion in 1863. Charles T. Russell created the Jehovah's Witness religion in 1872. Charles Parham created the Pentecostal religion in 1901. Every one of them has a man's name and a date on it.

Protestant Christians claim they are different from the Catholics. What did they keep from Roman Catholicism? White Jesus, white angels, white Jews; white Jesus sacrificed for everyone on the planet; white Jesus born Christmas Day, December 25th; Sunday worship as a new Sabbath; Christ rose on Easter; Mother's Day, New Year's Eve, Thanksgiving Day. Traditions of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ. And it was Pope Nicholas V, the father of the transatlantic slave trade, who in that famous bull by which he granted the unknown world to the Portuguese and Spaniards expressly permitted and ordered the Christians to reduce all infidels into slavery — an order zealously executed by both these nations.

sense.text:
“Wherefore are we counted as beasts, and reputed vile in your sight?” Counted as beasts. That is the question, and the answer is written in their own books.

This is where the circuses all started. Barnum and Bailey Circus in New York City did not start with lions and tigers and bears — it started with our foremothers, our forefathers, our sons and daughters. They were the zoos. Ota Benga, age 25, was exhibited at the Louisiana Purchase Exposition in St. Louis in 1904, brought from the Kasai River, Congo Free State, South Central Africa. When they put him in the zoo they forced him to walk around with a chimpanzee. He didn't want that monkey; they said you have to walk around with this monkey. And they chiseled all his natural teeth down to make him look savage. He was exhibited at New York's Bronx Zoo in 1906, and when he realized he would not be able to return to Africa he shot himself. He was 32.

They had black people from Australia in that zoo. They had black children from Congo in that zoo. An African girl was shown at the 1958 Expo in Brussels, Belgium, that featured a Congo village with visitors watching her from behind wooden fences — 1958, that is not that long ago. The Sara Kaba women were brought to the Berlin Zoo in 1931 to be put on display, the scars over their mouths covering their lip plates. And remember, this is after chattel slavery. White people would come from miles around to look at black people in that damn zoo, praising white Jesus, saying we are all one in Christ.

The book tries to make it seem nice, saying there was public protest, especially from the clergy. No, there wasn't. This thing went on for almost a century. So where was the clergy? It's all a lie.

“For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.” This is what black Christians often forget.

That scripture did not apply to us from 1441 all the way to 1964. Look at the images of our people in the zoos and in the slave ships and ask where the whosoever was. It contradicts what Christians say about John 3:16, and that is why Christians don't want to deal with those images. No, no, we don't want to talk about that.

precepts.why:
“But ye are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, an holy nation, a peculiar people; that ye should shew forth the praises of him who hath called you out of darkness into his marvellous light.” Next to that verse write Deuteronomy 7 and 6 and Deuteronomy 14 verse 2, because that is where it is taken from.

Read nine and ten together, because verse 10 is the part we want: “Which in time past were not a people, but are now the people of God: which had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.” During the time of Peter and the apostles the Northern Kingdom was not considered a people.

How does that relate to us today? After emancipation we were considered only three-fifths of a man. In fact they were still calling us property. We had to walk around with signs trying to convince the white man, I am a man. We weren't considered a people during the time you are looking at on the screen, just like during the time of Peter and them the Northern Kingdom was not considered a people. But now the truth is coming out that we are the people of God. During slavery we had not obtained mercy — but now have obtained mercy. Think about it.

“There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither bond nor free, there is neither male nor female: for ye are all one in Christ Jesus.”

From 1441 up to 1964 that scripture did not apply to black people in white people's churches. It was never taught. Why? Because they always saw us as those pictures show us. Those verses only started being taught in regards to black and brown people once the civil rights movement was started.

Look at the pictures of the Protestants standing with slavery and ask, what happened to there is neither bond nor free? There is a difference there. Churches don't want to talk about it. They don't even want to think about it, because looking at those images contradicts what Christians say about John 3:16 and what Christians say about Galatians 3:28.

sense.text:
“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.” Paul was in the spirit when he wrote this. The white man came, Rome came, and started preaching another Jesus that the apostles never preached.

Another Jesus has a face and a date. In a book published in 1920 there is a bust of the savior posed for by Caesar Borgia: the original of this bust was found in the church of San Salvador in Termis, now destroyed, and it is an open secret that Caesar Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, had posed for it. Salvador means savior. Caesar Borgia posed for the new image of Jesus — the Renaissance image, the Caucasian image. That is what they did.

And notice what comes bundled with him. Once you accept another Jesus you get another spirit, and you get another gospel, meaning a false gospel. People say it doesn't matter what he looks like, it's his message that counts. But the Bible says the image, the spirit and the gospel come together. The way we bear with them is through teaching. That is how we teach.

That is also why we don't have to start with the Trinity — the word isn't even in the Bible. Let's start with white Jesus; have Christians prove that. Then the angels; have Christians prove that. What about white Jews; have Christians prove the Jews are white. Then go down the list. Don't let Christians pull you from these basic things to the co-eternalness of God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit, because they don't want you to deal with this right here. It will blow a hole in their whole doctrine. We're not debating the blood. You prove to us Jesus was a white man. Prove to us the Jews are white. We want to see it with Biblical reference. They know they're going to get destroyed. They can't do it. Not with the Bible, they can't.

precepts.why:
Here is a precept for another Jesus. “And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them: and power was given him over all kindreds, and tongues, and nations.” The him here is the white man — Spain, Portugal, Rome. Remember Pope Nicholas V wrote a papal bull allowing Spain and Portugal to enslave all infidels, and it started with Africa. This white man made war against us, and they overcame us. The white man ruled the world.

“And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.” That is the part we want. All that dwell upon the earth shall worship him. No matter where you go in the earth, you could go to Saudi Arabia and ask them who is that, and they all say one thing: Jesus Christ. Go to Papua New Guinea — who is that? Jesus. Go around the world, and nowhere will you hear I don't know.

You know who says I don't know now? Lying black Christians, because they know they're going to get cut in scriptures. So they say we don't know who that is, nobody knows, I don't think that's Jesus. You're a liar. Ask their child, and their child will reveal the truth of these lying black Christians. Everybody says that's Jesus. So the Bible is a true book. You are not going to convince me the Bible ain't true.

Let's prove who the saints are real quick, because Christians will tell you the saints is anybody that believes in white Jesus. That's a lie.

“He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.”

So the children of Israel are the saints. That is who Revelation 13:7 says war was made with, and that is who was overcome.

Here is another precept. “And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.”

Put the Salvador bust back up and read verse 5 again. Many shall come in my name saying I am Christ, and shall deceive many. This white man took that image throughout the world when he conquered and enslaved our people.

Then he got all the other nations and races to accept that this is Jesus Christ, the savior of all mankind. That is the deceiving of many, exactly as Christ said it would happen.

The Jesus the apostles preached is described plainly. “His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire.”

That first white, write this down, means pure — pure like wool. When you look up white, one of the meanings is purity, pure. Then it says as white as snow, fully white. And his eyes were as a flame of fire, because he drank wine in moderation.

“And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace.” So this is brass being burned in a furnace. What color does it turn? Black. You want to tell me you don't know what color Jesus is when you're looking right at it? Jesus is a black man. That is the Jesus the apostles preached, and the one Caesar Borgia posed for is another Jesus.

What does it mean, another spirit? Because what comes with another Jesus is another spirit. Here is that spirit.

“And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof ye have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world.” If you don't confess Jesus is a black man, you are not of God.

They say Jesus is white — that's antichrist. Nobody knows what Jesus looks like — that's antichrist. Jesus is a rainbow color — antichrist. They say oh no, he didn't come in the flesh; and if they do say he came in the flesh, what flesh? Chinese flesh? They say he's olive. Olives come in three colors: green, brown and black. Which one? Then they go Middle Eastern. You see what they do? It's always some word games with them, always some tricks with the Christian.

Now, another gospel. When the Bible says another gospel, let's read what the gospel actually is. Read down to 11.

“Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers, For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine; According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.”

All those laws are according to what? The glorious gospel. Christians say no, the law is not according to the gospel — Christians don't know the Bible. They say you don't keep no law in Jesus. That is why Paul said if you accept another Jesus you get another spirit and you get another gospel. The gospel of white Jesus teaches don't keep no law, but the Bible says the law is according to the glorious gospel. So the laws of God are according to the glorious gospel. Christians don't admit that, because they got another spirit, because they worship another Jesus that the apostles never taught about.

A lot of you make the mistake of thinking that the white man serves the same God of the Bible that we do. No, they don't. Here are some precepts for another Jesus. “Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.” Then shall the white man's mind change.

How do we know this is talking about the white man? Jump up above to verse 6: “For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.” During the time of Habakkuk, Babylon came in and took over the lands. Didn't they do that here in the Americas? They did it in Europe — they went throughout Europe and took those castles, they killed us and enslaved us throughout Europe, then they came to the Americas, killed our people here, and enslaved us here.

Read on and it is the conquistadors. “They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves. Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.” Look at the horses — when they brought horses here they had armor on them. From far means from Spain, from Portugal. And what was their symbol? The eagle.

“They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.” Why did they come? For violence. God says they came for violence. You think Christopher Columbus came with an armada for peace? Then why did he bring conquistadors? Conquistador means conquerors. Why did he come with groups of men called the conquerors? Oh, he was lost, he was on a harmless expedition. That's a lie. They came from the east, and we are the captivity that they gathered as the sand.

“And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.” The kings that were set up here, they scoffed at them. They heap dust — they heap Christianity and lies, and take it. They caused confusion. Then shall his mind change: now that we destroyed you, we can all get together, we can be at peace with you now. And he shall pass over and offend, imputing this his power unto his god — little g. Who is the god they are talking about? Caesar Borgia's bust. That is his god. When we say their god is not our god, their god is not the God of the Bible, this is the evidence.

You may ask how we use Habakkuk's Chaldeans for the white man. Come along with us here. “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” It is talking about the children of Edom.

Then: “O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.” What is it calling Edom here? O daughter of Babylon.

So go back to Habakkuk, where the Chaldeans are the same Babylonians, and read verse 6 again. Edom is the daughter of Babylon, so the bitter and hasty nation that marches through the breadth of the land to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs is this white man. The medieval chroniclers say expressly that Edom means the Roman Empire or the European powers, and Benjamin of Tudela, circa 1160, calls Rome the Edomite capital and the Pope the head of the Edomitish religion. Christians say Edom was all destroyed. That is not what the scholars said.

Let's get another one for his god. “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.” The he is the white man, and this strange god is the same god that Christians worship today, white Jesus.

He shall cause them — meaning his fellow Europeans — to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain. That is what they did at the Berlin Conference in 1884 when they all sat down in a meeting and said let's split Africa up. The Italians took a piece, the French took some, Germany took some, the British took some, the Spanish took some, Belgium took some, the Portuguese took some. And they gave the Amalekites the land of Israel later on in 1948. They said we have to give Europeans this power.

Even during the time of the Greeks the world was divided up; you think they only did it then? They divided the land for gain: how can we get paid? Africa will never be free. Look at what is happening with France now that Burkina Faso kicked them out — their economy is falling, all kinds of riots are breaking out, and they said we can't let this happen to our European powers. The only time there will be peace on earth is when Christ sets up the kingdom on earth with the 12 tribes of Israel in total control of the planet. Then there will be peace on earth.

sense.text:
Black Christians mourn for their oppressors. They love to weep for their oppressors. Here is what our own people did when they wanted position under the Greeks.

“This Simon now, of whom we spake afore, having been a betrayer of the money, and of his country, slandered Onias, as if he had terrified Heliodorus, and been the worker of these evils. Thus was he bold to call him a traitor, that had deserved well of the city, and tendered his own nation, and was so zealous of the laws.” These were Greeks against the Israelites. Onias was an Israelite, and the trouble came from his own side.

When their hatred went so far that murders were committed by Simon's faction, Onias, seeing the danger of this contention and that Apollonius the governor of Celosyria and Phenice did rage and increase Simon's malice, “went to the king, not to be an accuser of his countrymen, but seeking the good of all, both publick and private”. He saw it was impossible that the state should continue quiet unless the king did look thereunto.

“But after the death of Seleucus, when Antiochus, called Epiphanes, took the kingdom, Jason the brother of Onias laboured underhand to be high priest.” Jason was an Israelite, and he was the wicked brother.

He bought the office: “Promising unto the king by intercession three hundred and threescore talents of silver, and of another revenue eighty talents: Beside this, he promised to assign an hundred and fifty more, if he might have licence to set him up a place for exercise, and for the training up of youth in the fashions of the heathen, and to write them of Jerusalem by the name of Antiochians.”

“Which when the king had granted, and he had gotten into his hand the rule he forthwith brought his own nation to Greekish fashion.” That is what we want you to see. This is the same thing Christians do today. They want us under white supremacy. They want to bring us to the Greekish fashion.

precepts.why:
Jason paid for the priesthood. Now you have to ask the question: if that is the case, how did the scribes and Pharisees get their positions?

“Then gathered the chief priests and the Pharisees a council, and said, What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him: and the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.”

They feared Rome taking away their place. Who gave them their place in society? Rome gave them their seats of authority, and the Pharisees understood that. So it was the same thing from the time of Maccabees: the white man was controlling who sits in seats of power. How do your black ministers become ministers today? They have to go to the white man's schools.

What did they teach once they had those seats? Was it God's divine commandments? Let's see.

“Then came to Jesus scribes and Pharisees, which were of Jerusalem, saying, Why do thy disciples transgress the tradition of the elders? for they wash not their hands when they eat bread.” They taught traditions, traditions handed down to them.

“But he answered and said unto them, Why do ye also transgress the commandment of God by your tradition?” Examine this. What do Christians teach — the commandments of God, or traditions of men? Traditions of men. White Jesus, Sunday worship, Christmas, New Year's Eve, Mother's Day, Father's Day. That's nowhere in the Bible. Christians are those Pharisees we read about. If you ever wanted to know who the Pharisees are today, it's them.

sense.text:
“Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.” So you had rulers in Jerusalem during the time of Isaiah.

The same rulers Isaiah spoke about and prophesied about were the same rulers during the time of Christ, and those same rulers during the time of Christ are the same rulers today. Those same spirits — they are all back. Watch what they did.

“Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement.” We made an agreement with Rome. During the time of Maccabees they made an agreement with Greece. During the time of Christ they made an agreement with Rome. Today our people make an agreement with America. It's the same thing going on. That is the death he is talking about, this white man.

And with hell are we at agreement, meaning the hellish condition we live in, our people are at agreement with. If you notice, black clergy and black politicians have made no changes in black society. None. The same poverty exists today that was there some time ago. Nothing has changed for our people. We still fill the prison houses. Nothing has changed.

“When the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us.” When judgment shall come, Christians say it shall not come unto us, nothing's going to happen to us. Why? “For we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves.” We believe in white Jesus; white Jesus will come to our rescue, this white man will always save us. And under the lies of Christianity we have hid ourselves.

“Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.”

I lay in Zion. Not I lay in China. Not I lay in Saudi Arabia. Not I lay in Europe. I lay in Zion — that's the 12 tribes of Israel. The stone, the tried stone, the precious corner stone, that's all Christ.

He that believeth shall not make haste, meaning make haste to run from the truth. If you don't believe, you will make haste. You look for a reason: I'm leaving, I'm out of here. You made a joke about Haiti, I'm mad, now I'm leaving. Brothers couldn't pass MOV because they're too fat and sloppy, so they said I've got to leave — I can't run around the block, I can't do a push-up, I can't stop eating chicken and watermelon. Then they say y'all are evil. You made haste over something so stupid, so trivial.

“Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.”

The destruction will sweep away the refuge of Christianity. No matter where they hide, they are going to get caught in the destruction that comes.

“And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.”

God says the covenant you made with that white man shall be disannulled, and your agreement with your people staying in hell shall not stand. Then ye shall be trodden down by it — you are going to get put to death. That is the message Christ is saying.

“From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.”

From the time the teaching goes forth, it shall take you. Morning by morning shall it pass over, meaning the teachings that they are going to constantly hear. By day and by night, because the teachings are from sunup to sundown.

And it shall be a vexation only to understand the report. It vexes a Christian spirit only to understand the report: I've been believing white Jesus is my God all my life, and because of pride I can't get over it. So this vexation is going to catch you. It's catching all of them.

“For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.”

This bed is too short. Here you are, six foot five in a three-foot bed. You know what that bed represents? The lies of Christianity. You're trying to find comfort, a six-foot-five negro in a three-foot bed of lies.

And the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it — a five-inch blanket. You're trying to get warmth in your lies, because that's what the blanket represents, your lies. You're trying to get warm. There's no comfort there. Your Christian lies are over. That's what the Bible is saying.

precepts.why:
What is that sure foundation? What is that precious corner stone? We're coming back to Isaiah, so don't drop it.

“And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone.”

Jesus Christ being the chief corner stone. So when God says behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, that is Christ, and he is laid in Zion — the 12 tribes of Israel.

sense.text:
When the Bible talks about enemies you have two groups: enemies among your own people, and enemies of other nations. Here is the law about your own.

“Thou shalt not see thy brother's ox or his sheep go astray, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt in any case bring them again unto thy brother. And if thy brother be not nigh unto thee, or if thou know him not, then thou shalt bring it unto thine own house, and it shall be with thee until thy brother seek after it, and thou shalt restore it to him again.” Notice it keeps saying your brother, your brother.

“In like manner shalt thou do with his ass; and so shalt thou do with his raiment; and with all lost thing of thy brother's, which he hath lost, and thou hast found, shalt thou do likewise: thou mayest not hide thyself. Thou shalt not see thy brother's ass or his ox fall down by the way, and hide thyself from them: thou shalt surely help him to lift them up again.” Notice again he uses the term your brother. That is the key to everything else read here.

precepts.why:
Now here is a precept to what we just read. “If thou meet thine enemy's ox or his ass going astray, thou shalt surely bring it back to him again.” That goes with what we just read in Deuteronomy 22, but here notice it says your enemy.

How do we know that enemy is the enemy of your people and not the other nations? Jump down and read from verse 22: “But if thou shalt indeed obey his voice, and do all that I speak; then I will be an enemy unto thine enemies, and an adversary unto thine adversaries.” Obey God's voice, and God takes up your enemies himself.

Then verse 23 names who those other enemies are: “For mine Angel shall go before thee, and bring thee in unto the Amorites, and the Hittites, and the Perizzites, and the Canaanites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites: and I will cut them off.” What does it mean, I will cut them off? God is saying I will kill them. So the enemy that we are supposed to help is the enemy among our brothers. I might not like you, you might not like me, but God commands us to help each other.

This is the same thing, and this is where negros get hemmed up. “Ye have heard that it hath been said, Thou shalt love thy neighbour, and hate thine enemy.” Eye for an eye, tooth for tooth; he did this to me, I'm going to do that to him.

“But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you.”

That is what we were just reading about. That enemy is the enemy of your people. It is not saying Rome, you just slaughtered a thousand Israelites, let me pray for you. That is the stupidest thought. And black Christians will hold that idea. That's what Pastor Pam was just doing.

Watch this one, because they use it the same wrong way. “Rejoice not when thine enemy falleth, and let not thine heart be glad when he stumbleth.”

That is talking about the enemies of your people, your own brother. How do I know that is the proper understanding? Pay attention to what comes next in the scriptures that follow.

Read it with the law of the brother in Deuteronomy 22 and it fits perfectly: among your own people you do not gloat when your brother goes down. It was never written about the nations that slaughter us.

How do I know that is the proper understanding of Proverbs 24? Pay attention. “The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.”

The Bible says the righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked — we're going to dance for joy in the blood of the wicked.

“So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.” So there is a rejoicing God himself puts in the mouth of the righteous, and it is over the wicked of the nations.

Wait a minute — is the Bible contradicting itself? No, the Bible ain't contradicting itself. Your pastor is contradicting it.

“When it goeth well with the righteous, the city rejoiceth: and when the wicked perish, there is shouting.”

And when the wicked perish, there is shouting. You know what that shouting is? Hallelujah, hallelujah. We're going to rejoice when they go down.

Stop listening to these dumb pastors that keep you in a mental state of slavery to white supremacy, and read this.

“There be nine things which I have judged in mine heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that hath joy of his children; and he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy.”

See that right there? And he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy. That is counted among the happy things. That's something to rejoice over.

“Then they returned, every man of Judah and Jerusalem, and Jehoshaphat in the forefront of them, to go again to Jerusalem with joy; for the Lord had made them to rejoice over their enemies.”

See that? God made us to rejoice over our enemies. We won the battle.

So what is Philip Anthony Mitchell talking about? God himself is the one who made them to rejoice.

“And the children of Israel that were present at Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness: and the Levites and the priests praised the Lord day by day, singing with loud instruments unto the Lord.”

You might be saying, wait a minute, what does this have to do with the topic? It has everything to do with the topic. Passover is about the destruction of Egypt and the deliverance of the Israelites.

We rejoice seven days every time we keep Passover. It's about us celebrating God destroying those dirty Egyptians and delivering us from Egypt. Passover is a celebration of God killing our enemies.

Go to the last chapter in the addition to Esther in the Apocrypha. “For Almighty God hath turned to joy unto them the day, wherein the chosen people should have perished.”

“Ye shall therefore among your solemn feasts keep it an high day with all feasting.” This is about the feast of Purim. It was a day celebrating God allowing us to kill our enemies, and Esther said to celebrate that day.

So what do you mean we're not supposed to rejoice over the fall of the other nations that are trying to destroy us? Philip Michael Anthony don't know what the hell he's talking about.

sense.text:
These black Christians never mourn for their own people. Watch this.

“In those days went there out of Israel wicked men, who persuaded many, saying, Let us go and make a covenant with the heathen that are round about us: for since we departed from them we have had much sorrow.”

This goes with what we read in Isaiah 28 verse 14 and 15 about a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement. Notice it says there went out of Israel wicked men who persuaded many, saying let us go and make a covenant with the heathen — with the Greeks. That's what it's talking about, with the white man.

precepts.why:
“Then came ungodly persons, who hated their own people, went unto the king, and told him that Jonathan besieged the tower.”

I can guarantee you today that would be black Christians. Ungodly persons who hated their own people, going to the king with it.

Listen good, write this down: a black Christian will mourn for the oppressor but not for the oppressed. A black Christian urban apologist will mourn for the oppressor but not the oppressed.

sense.text:
This is the prophecy. Yes, there are prophecies in Deuteronomy, no matter what these dumb stupid Christians say.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people.” That's called slavery. “And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand.”

The Bible says we would not have military might, political might or economic might. We would have no might, meaning no power to get our sons and daughters back.

“The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up.” Our resources and all our labors. The white man ate up everything.

“And thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway.” How long? Alway. The Bible says alway.

There will never be a time in America where all black and brown people, the Israelites, will be successful and rule. That's not happening. The Bible says we would be crushed and oppressed, and how long, brothers? Alway. That's why we need a savior.

precepts.why:
“So I returned, and considered all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold the tears of such as were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.”

This is King Solomon looking at a vision that he saw about oppression. He saw the oppressed people with tears in their eyes constantly, and they had no comforter.

And on the side of their oppressors there was power — nuclear power, political power, economic power. But they had no comforter. The Israelites had no power. A black Christian will mourn for the oppressor but not the oppressed.

“By reason of the multitude of oppressions they make the oppressed to cry: they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty.”

Don't our people cry out constantly because of the arm of the mighty? That is the oppressed and crushed alway of Deuteronomy 28 put into a cry.

And our people keep gunning for the hanging fruit instead of the root. In the series Snowfall everybody is against a brother named Franklin Saint, but Franklin is just the hanging fruit from the tree — he's not the root. The root was the CIA using Franklin to fund the war in Nicaragua, because they said we need that money, sold through drugs, to fund that war. Nobody sees that. Even when the black cop found out that is what it was all about, he still made Franklin his arch enemy, when his own white partner told him this is more than just this guy Franklin: once you get rid of him, the CIA is going to get a new guy, and it's going to continue. Franklin wasn't a good guy, he was destroying a whole community — but the arm of the mighty is the one making the oppressed to cry.

“The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.”

The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed. It doesn't say the Lord will be a refuge for the oppressor, but that is what Christians teach.

God's coming for the oppressors? No. He's coming for the oppressed. The oppressed are the Israelites that we read about in Deuteronomy 28:33. What is so hard to understand about that?

“And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.” God gave the Israelites into the hand of the heathen. Heathen means other nations.

And they that hated them ruled over them. That is the point — not a people who loved us, but a people that hated us ruling over us.

“Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.” See that? That is the same oppressed and crushed alway, and God is the one who said he gave them into that hand.

We are the oppressed, and I don't care if you've got a good job, you're still oppressed. “Thus saith the Lord my God; Feed the flock of the slaughter.” We are the flock of the slaughter. God said feed the flock of the slaughter.

“Whose possessors slay them, and hold themselves not guilty.” Meaning the people that rule over them kill them, and hold themselves not guilty. The white man consistently holds himself not guilty — there are very few cases where he holds himself guilty; the vast majority of the time it is not guilty.

“And they that sell them say, Blessed be the Lord; for I am rich: and their own shepherds pity them not.” And they that sell them say blessed be the Lord — that's Christians. White Christians say blessed be the Lord; they sold us into slavery. And here is the part about black Christians: and their own shepherds pity them not. Black Christians don't pity their own people. Black Christians say pull yourselves up by your bootstraps, if I did it you can do it, the white man loves everybody.

Charlie Kirk was murdered September 10th of this year, 2025. Trey Reed was murdered five days later, found hanging from a tree on September 15th at Delta State University in Cleveland, Mississippi — a 21-year-old college student, described as a warm, promising young man. The sheriff's department concluded suicide straight away; his grandfather J.B. said he told me they found Trey Reed in his room and he didn't even say possible suicide, he said suicide, something is not right. The NAACP said our people have not historically hung ourselves from trees. Colin Kaepernick paid for an independent investigator, and it turned out the back of this young man's head was bust in. So it was not a suicide, it was a murder. And not one tear from a black dusty Christian. No moment of silence. No grief. No nothing. Assata Shakur died ten days after Charlie Kirk, on the 25th — a black revolutionary who was with the Black Panther Party, then the Black Liberation Army — and not one mention of her name. Sonya Massey said I rebuke you in the name of Jesus, and five foot one, 130 pounds, she was such a threat to that six-foot-four gorilla that he shot and murdered her in the face. Not one black Christian mourned for her. Breonna Taylor was sleeping in her bed. Sandra Bland just came from a job interview. Ahmaud Arbery was jogging. Trayvon Martin was getting Skittles. Philando Castile was in a car with his girlfriend and baby and told a cop I have a gun and I have a license for the gun, and was still shot. Kendrick Johnson was at gym class and was found rolled in a mat. Rasheem Carter was an electrician doing his job; he told his mother if anything happens to me, and gave the names of the white men, and they said a wild animal did that to his skull. Animals don't kill like that. Only the two-legged animal kills like that. Tamir Rice was 12 years old playing with a plastic toy gun and was just blasted away. Maria Florendo Rios Perez de Velasquez went to the wrong house to clean and the dude shot her through the closed door while her husband stood holding her lifeless body crying. Not one Christian mentioned her name. Their own shepherds pity them not.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts; The children of Israel and the children of Judah were oppressed together: and all that took them captives held them fast; they refused to let them go.”

When you read about oppression in the Bible, it is talking about the children of Judah and the children of Israel, the two kingdoms, being oppressed together.

These nations refused to let us go. During World War II, when black men were trying to fly to Ethiopia to help fight against Mussolini, America shut that down — you can look it up. They said black people are forbidden to leave this country to go help the Ethiopians. No more planes flying out of Chicago or wherever else they came from. Black men rallied together to go help Ethiopia, and America said no. That's just like in Exodus 1 where Pharaoh said we don't want them joining with our enemies. They held them fast; they refused to let them go.

“Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon.”

Black people, especially Christians, despise the word of God. And they trust in oppression — they trust in Christianity, they trust in democracy.

And perverseness: don't do no law, they trust in that. And stay thereon — and they want to stay like that.

“Thus saith the Lord; Behold, I will bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, and have mercy on his dwellingplaces.” God said I'm going to bring again the captivity of Jacob's tents, meaning bring us back to rulership, bring us back to the holy land. So he's not having mercy on all people on the planet; he's having mercy on Jacob's tents.

“And the city shall be builded upon her own heap, and the palace shall remain after the manner thereof. And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.” Out of the Israelites shall proceed thanksgiving. We're going to sing merry. We're going to have a whole lot of children, and we shall not be small.

“Their children also shall be as aforetime, and their congregation shall be established before me, and I will punish all that oppress them.” God said he will punish all that oppress us. Do you hear what the Bible is saying? All the oppressors are going to get punished. Every last one of them. Nobody's going to escape. Give the Lord a hand for that thing — he's going to punish all our oppressors.

sense.text:
Who were the Gentiles the Apostle Paul went to? Here is the answer in one verse.

“The land of Zabulon, and the land of Nephthalim, by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles.”

What is it calling Zebulun and Naphtali? Gentiles. It's calling them Gentiles. Two tribes of Israel, called Gentiles right there in the text.

The scholars know this. Rabbinic literature almost totally ignores the vast Western Diaspora that existed at the time, which is noticeable compared with the relatively large number of places in that Diaspora mentioned in chapter 2 of Acts and in the chapters describing the journeys of Paul, Acts chapter 13, as well as in the Pauline Epistles, which give a comprehensive picture of the geography of the Western Jewish Greek-speaking Diaspora. In the West, namely the Greek-speaking Mediterranean world, the Jews wrote and spoke only Greek; whereas in the East, Palestine and eastward, Hebrew and Aramaic prevailed. Why did they only know Greek? From the time of the Maccabees, when the Greeks forced us to learn their language and customs. So Paul went to the Western Jewish Greek-speaking Diaspora. The scholars know that. It's black Christians that don't understand that. No, Paul went to everybody — no, he didn't.

precepts.why:
“Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of God should first have been spoken to you.” That was the Jews in Jerusalem, the Jews in that area.

“But seeing ye put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.”

They turned to the Greek-speaking Jews. They went to those other Israelites that were scattered abroad, that were speaking and living as Greeks.

Can I prove that? Now Corinth is under the Greeks, and most Christians say the Corinthians were Greeks. Let's read what it says.

“Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea; And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea.”

All our fathers. He is saying to the Corinthians, all our fathers were with Moses. So what were the Corinthians? Israelites. The Chinese were not there. The Arabs were not there.

“Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.”

What dumb idols? Greek idols.

So the Corinthians were Israelites following Greek customs. That is what the books proved, and here Paul says it to their face: ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols.

All through the New Testament you read about Jew and Gentile, Jew and Greek. Now look at this. “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, saith the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, and write them in their hearts: and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people.”

Read above that, verse 8: “For finding fault with them, he saith, Behold, the days come, saith the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah.” Now we know Judah is the full word for Jew. But didn't it say Israel and Judah? That goes back to the kingdom being split into two.

Why doesn't he say Gentiles there? He makes it plain who he's talking about. Those two kingdoms — the Jews and the Gentiles are Judah and Israel. He didn't forget and say oh, I forgot, I was supposed to talk about the Gentiles. He didn't make any mistakes. He said what I'm really talking about is the kingdom of Israel and the kingdom of Judah.

sense.text:
Christians love this one, and they use it to say you don't have to do anything. “Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.”

So they say, see, you are not justified by the deeds of the law. And they say the deeds of the law means not committing adultery, not stealing, not killing. No, that's not talking about that. Was Joseph justified by not committing adultery? Yes. He refused to commit adultery with Potiphar's wife, and he was justified.

So what is this meaning? The deeds of the law is referring to those offerings, those sacrifices. And for by the law is the knowledge of sin is talking about those sin offerings for your sins.

“But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets.” Without what law? The laws of sacrifices.

“Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference.” That righteousness comes by the faith of Jesus Christ, not by bringing a kid of the goats.

precepts.why:
Here is a precept for the deeds of the law. Pay attention.

“Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and wipe not out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for the offices thereof.”

My what? My good deeds that I have done for the house of my God. So now we have to ask what those good deeds were, and Nehemiah tells us himself a few verses earlier.

What were the good deeds? Verse 9.

“Then I commanded, and they cleansed the chambers: and thither brought I again the vessels of the house of God, with the meat offering and the frankincense.”

See that? Meat offerings and the frankincense. So when Romans says by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified, it is talking about meat offerings.

Get Leviticus chapter four as the next precept. What is the knowledge of sin?

“Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.”

Romans says for by the law is the knowledge of sin. Read verse 23 again and you see what that knowledge brings: an offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish.

Jump down to 28. “Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.”

For by the law is the knowledge of sin — and the knowledge of sin is tied to the offering every time.

So go back to Romans 3:20 again. Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: the deeds of the law is referring to those offerings, those sacrifices. For by the law is the knowledge of sin is talking about those sin offerings for your sins. Everybody got that?

Watch this. “(For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.”

See that right there? So a Christian goes, wait a minute, that's contradictory, Romans 2:13 seems like it contradicts Romans 3:20.

No. Romans 3:20 is talking about sacrifices, old dumb one. The hell is wrong with you? The doers of the law shall be justified — that stands.

Now we want to talk about the works of the law. We dealt with the deeds of the law; the works of the law is the same thing, but let's just read these verses. Write this down.

“Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone.”

The works of the law. Write that down and hold it, because one verse in Nehemiah is going to answer this one and the two that follow.

“Knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law, but by the faith of Jesus Christ, even we have believed in Jesus Christ, that we might be justified by the faith of Christ, and not by the works of the law: for by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified.”

There is the works of the law again, three times in one verse.

So the question is, what is the works of the law? Christians never ask it; they just assume it means the commandments.

“This only would I learn of you, Received ye the Spirit by the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?”

That is the third one. So the question is, what is the works of the law?

Nehemiah chapter 10 verse 33 will answer Romans 9:32, Galatians 2:16 and Galatians 3 verse 2.

“For the shewbread, and for the continual meat offering, and for the continual burnt offering, of the sabbaths, of the new moons, for the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make an atonement for Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.”

For all the what? The work. For all the work of the house of our God. So the works of the law are those sacrifices. Does everybody understand that? Don't ever let a Christian confound you in any verses. Christians don't know the Bible. We do.

sense.text:
Now, salvation. They say salvation is for everybody. Let's see who God says it is for.

“For thus saith the Lord; Sing with gladness for Jacob, and shout among the chief of the nations: publish ye, praise ye, and say, O Lord, save thy people, the remnant of Israel.”

Save thy people, the remnant of Israel. That is the prayer God himself puts in the mouth of the prophet, and here are a few scriptures that precede the apostles on the same thing.

precepts.why:
“And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.”

Right now we are a curse among the heathen. What do you mean, a curse? That is what they call us. No good, dirty shame, the black man ain't no good — that's what they say about us.

So will I save you. Who? The house of Judah and the house of Israel. And God said fear not, but let your hands be strong. So the salvation is for the Israelites.

“I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.”

Salvation in Zion for Israel, my glory. Not for the planet — for Israel.

The churches have been deceiving people for centuries on this one verse alone.

What did the angel say? What did the angel tell Mary?

“And she shall bring forth a son, and thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.”

His people are the Israelites. That is in the announcement of his birth, before he preached a word.

When Christ was an adult, what did he say?

“But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

Christ said I'm only sent for the lost sheep of Israel. The angel said it at his birth and he said it himself as a grown man.

“Him hath God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, for to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins.”

To give repentance to Israel. So it's for Israel.

That is after the resurrection, out of the mouth of the apostles themselves.

What did Paul teach? “Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises.”

Every one of those belongs to the Israelites: the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service of God, the promises.

“Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.” So Christ only came for the Israelites. That's what Paul said.

“Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.”

Paul's heart's desire and prayer is for Israel, that they might be saved.

He said it in Romans 9, and he says it again in Romans 10.

“And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.”

All Israel shall be saved. There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

Y'all see that right there? Jeremiah said save thy people, the remnant of Israel, and Paul lands in the same place: all Israel shall be saved.

sense.text:
Somebody will say, but what about if people ask for forgiveness of their sins? Won't God accept them? Paul was a murderer. Y'all know the history.

“And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry; Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief. And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.”

Paul was a murderer. He did it ignorantly. He got forgiven. Everybody with me, right? Now the question is this: does that same grace, does that same mercy, extend to Edom? That's what we're going to find out.

precepts.why:
“As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.”

God said he hates Esau. Not that he was displeased with him for a season — hated.

So before we even get to whether Edom can repent, God has already told us where he stands on Esau.

Now watch this. This is one of the Israelites speaking to the Greeks while they were killing us.

“And when he was at the last gasp, he said, Thou like a fury takest us out of this present life, but the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws, unto everlasting life.”

See what the brother said? He said the King of the world shall raise us up, who have died for his laws. The resurrection he claims is for those who kept the laws.

Another brother that was about to die. “So when he was ready to die he said thus, It is good, being put to death by men, to look for hope from God to be raised up again by him: as for thee, thou shalt have no resurrection to life.”

Why is it good? To look for hope from God to be raised up again by him.

And then he turns it on the king: as for thee, thou shalt have no resurrection to life. No resurrection to life at all.

Another brother that was about to get put to death. “Then looked he unto the king, and said, Thou hast power over men, thou art corruptible, thou doest what thou wilt; yet think not that our nation is forsaken of God.”

Don't think that the Israelites are forsaken of God. You just wait a while.

“But abide a while, and behold his great power, how he will torment thee and thy seed.” He said the King will torment you and your seed. Not just the man — his seed with him.

Watch what Paul says to the Hebrews, because people always talk about the Apostle Paul. “Lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one morsel of meat sold his birthright.” So Esau sold his birthright.

“For ye know how that afterward, when he would have inherited the blessing, he was rejected.” God rejected Esau.

Here is the point we want: “for he found no place of repentance, though he sought it carefully with tears.” Esau wept and cried, and God said no, I'm never accepting you, I reject you, I don't care about your tears. To hell with your tears. Paul was a murderer and obtained mercy because he did it ignorantly in unbelief — but Esau sought repentance carefully with tears and found no place for it.

You might think that ain't good enough, so we'll get another one for you. Watch this devil, Antiochus Epiphanes — meaning God manifest on earth — another Edomite. “Here therefore, being plagued, he began to leave off his great pride, and to come to the knowledge of himself by the scourge of God, his pain increasing every moment.” He got sick, and now he started to come to his senses.

“And when he himself could not abide his own smell, he said these words, It is meet to be subject unto God, and that a man that is mortal should not proudly think of himself if he were God.” He smelled so bad he couldn't stand himself. Notice what he is saying now — this is called repentance. It is good to be subject to God.

Then look at everything he vowed. “This wicked person vowed also unto the Lord, who now no more would have mercy upon him, saying thus, That the holy city (to the which he was going in haste to lay it even with the ground, and to make it a common buryingplace,) he would set at liberty.” Antiochus was going to destroy Jerusalem, and now he says I'm going to set Jerusalem at liberty. “And as touching the Jews, whom he had judged not worthy so much as to be buried, but to be cast out with their children to be devoured of the fowls and wild beasts, he would make them all equals to the citizens of Athens.” I'm going to make the Jews all equal to the citizens of Athens. “And the holy temple, which before he had spoiled, he would garnish with goodly gifts, and restore all the holy vessels with many more, and out of his own revenue defray the charges belonging to the sacrifices.”

And this next verse: “Yea, and that also he would become a Jew himself, and go through all the world that was inhabited, and declare the power of God.” I'll convert, God. I will convert. I will teach the gospel, God. “But for all this his pains would not cease: for the just judgment of God was come upon him.” So he writes a whole letter to the Jews, and none of it moved God, because God now no more would have mercy upon him.

“Thus the murderer and blasphemer having suffered most grievously, as he entreated other men, so died he a miserable death in a strange country in the mountains.”

So there was no repentance for him. Does everybody understand that?

God said I don't care if you convert, I don't care if you teach the gospel around the world, there's no repentance for you. To hell with your tears. Nobody gives a damn about you. That's the same thing Paul was saying to the Hebrews.

“And the house of Jacob shall be a fire, and the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau for stubble, and they shall kindle in them, and devour them; and there shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau; for the Lord hath spoken it.”

God said I'm going to burn them away. There shall not be any remaining of the house of Esau.

How is a Christian going to read that and say that's a lie? God said I'm getting rid of all of them.

And not just them. Get mad now, because the other nations are going to have a little grace period — but what's going to happen at the very end?

“For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished.”

Though I destroy all the nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee. God said I'm going to get rid of all the nations except you Israelites. Get mad. Tell your mommas to get mad now. That's in the Bible. I didn't write this. So your little East Indian friend, your little Chinese friend, you can say bye.

sense.text:
When you go to Acts 2, this is what speaking in tongues was.

“And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born?”

Speaking in tongues was known languages. The one speaking in tongues didn't understand it, but the listeners understood it. That is not what's going on in church with that noise they make.

Glossolalia, or speaking in tongues, is the practice of vocalizing speech-like syllables that lack any comprehensible meaning, often during religious services. It lacks any comprehensible meaning. And other practices similar to glossolalia include shamanism, where practices can involve ecstatic utterance as a form of communication with spirits, and paganism, like voodoo, where certain practices may also include forms of ecstatic speech, making glossolalia a cross-cultural phenomenon rather than being specific to one religion. So it's not new. It's all garbage.

Black people went from glossolalia to coming into the truth, and now some of them waking up to being Israelites say you have got to speak Hebrew. So did God command us to speak this new form of Hebrew that Eliezer Ben Yehuda created?

“For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.”

That's like in Acts 2, where the Holy Spirit came down. Israel was in different lands, and they had to reach and speak in the language that each one knew. That is what another tongue means here — not a made-up language.

The history is plain in their own books. Hebrew was spoken by the people of that name to the Babylonish captivity, soon after which it became a dead language. After their return from captivity the Jews spoke Syro-Chaldaic, although after the time of Alexander Greek became common. The learned among the Jews continued to write and speak Hebrew almost to the present day, but it is an impure dialect, termed Rabbinic; and the Syro-Chaldaic was nothing but Chaldee intermixed with some Hebrew peculiarities, differing so little from Hebrew that it might also be called a dialect of the same language. It is this Syro-Chaldaic that is called Hebrew in the New Testament. Modern Israeli Hebrew has only been around for about 150 years; before that, biblical Hebrew was a non-spoken language for around 2,000 years, used liturgically. Its revival is largely attributed to a Russian named Eliezer Yitzhak Perlman, an Ashkenazi Jewish linguist who changed his name to Eliezer Ben Yehuda; his native language was Yiddish, and he took the Sephardic pronunciation and overlaid it with European pronunciations heavily influenced by Yiddish, Russian, Polish and German. He said there are two things without which the Jews will not be a nation, their land and their language. So he created the language that black Israelites are arguing about today.

precepts.why:
“In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.”

So Paul even quoted Isaiah 28 about that. It was a big thing, speaking in tongues.

And when you read the chapter it says if there's no interpreter, be quiet. So now you have got Israelites that come out of the Christian church speaking a glossolalia, repenting as Israelites, and now they argue about a Hebrew that was made up by the white man.

sense.text:
“Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God” — meaning a leader. “And he shall go no more out” — meaning don't go out into captivity.

“And I will write upon him the name of my God.” Christ said I'm going to give you the name of my God. That means the Father. “And the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.”

So what are you arguing about? We go to the other side of the world and there's a black woman out there arguing about Hebrew, following Eliezer Ben Yehuda, and we're like, what is wrong with you? Christ said he is going to write the name on us himself.

precepts.why:
“His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.”

Do you know that there are Israelites that say they know the name? It says nobody knows it but himself. But there are black Israelites that seem to know. Brother, you're wrong. So the Bible is wrong and you're right?

Let me read the next verse: “And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” So what's wrong with that? That is the name given in the text.

We gave the black woman this. She understood it, but then she rejected it, because they must push Eliezer Ben Yehuda's form of Hebrew.

“Therefore wait ye upon me, saith the Lord, until the day that I rise up to the prey: for my determination is to gather the nations, that I may assemble the kingdoms, to pour upon them mine indignation, even all my fierce anger: for all the earth shall be devoured with the fire of my jealousy.” God's going to gather all the nations together — this is talking about Armageddon — and pour upon them his wrath.

Now here's the point, in verse 9. So when God destroys all nations, their armies, their military, what's he going to do? “For then will I turn to the people a pure language, that they may all call upon the name of the Lord, to serve him with one consent.” Then. So what are you fighting for? What are you on the street arguing for about a name? He said I'm going to give you the pure language after I destroy the nations and their armies. I don't see why that is so difficult to understand.

sense.text:
Watch the prophecy. “The word of the Lord that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.”

That sets the time: kings over Judah and a king over Israel, the two kingdoms standing at once.

“The beginning of the word of the Lord by Hosea. And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from the Lord.”

Why did God say to do that? Because the Israelites, us, we joined to the gods of the other nations. So he told Hosea to marry a whore and have her bear babies. That represents what the Israelites did to him.

“So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son. And the Lord said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.”

So the firstborn was called Jezreel. And God said I'm going to make Israel cease — meaning they were going to be destroyed, sent into captivity.

“And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.”

“And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And God said unto him, Call her name Lo–ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.”

Now she has a daughter. What does Lo–ruhamah mean? That is what the name means: no mercy for Israel. For I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel.

But I will utterly take them away — into captivity.

“But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.”

Mercy on the house of Judah, and the saving is not by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, nor by horses or horsemen. Write the righteous precept down: Second Kings 19 verse 30 to 36.

“Now when she had weaned Lo–ruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.” Now she has a son.

“Then said God, Call his name Lo–ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.”

That's what it means. Lo–ammi means not my people.

Now here's the prophecy. “Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.”

In the place — in America, in the lands we were carried captive. How was it said unto them, ye are not my people? They call us African-Americans, Puerto Ricans, Jamaicans, Haitians, Peruvians, Dominicans, Brazilians. That's how they say we're not God's people.

There it shall be said unto them, ye are the sons of the living God. So wherever we travel from America and go abroad, we let our people know: you are the Israelites that the Bible speaks of.

“Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.”

One head is Christ. And they shall come up out of the land.

So deliverance is only for Judah and Israel.

What does that have to do with language? Keep reading. “Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ru–hamah.”

Now you see that? Your brother Ammi — that goes back to chapter 1, where God said call his name Lo–ammi. And to your sisters Ru–hamah goes back to where she conceived and bare a daughter and God said call her name Lo–ruhamah. So it's talking about these same children, with the Lo taken off: no more not my people, no more no mercy.

“Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts.”

What did that represent? God wanted us to repent.

“Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.”

I will allure her through the scriptures, through the teachings. And bring her into the wilderness — the wilderness of Egypt.

And speak comfortably unto her: the laws of God. That's how you speak comfortably.

“And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.”

The valley of Achor for a door of hope, and she shall sing there as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.

“And it shall be at that day, saith the Lord, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.”

Thou shalt call me Ishi. That means my husband. Write that down: Ishi, my husband.

And shalt call me no more Baali — we shall no longer use Baali, meaning Lord.

Read that slow and emphasize the I. “For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.”

For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth. That is what Zephaniah 3:8 and 9 said, when he said I'm going to give you the pure language, the pure tongue.

And they shall no more be remembered by their name. Why? Because Christ said I'm going to give you the name of the Father, I'm going to give you my new name. He takes the names away and he gives the name. That is why there is nothing to argue about.

“And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.”

And I will break the bow, and the sword, and the battle out of the earth, meaning there shall be peace on earth. And God will make the 12 tribes to lie down safely.

“And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.”

I'm going to be married to the Israelites forever. In righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.

“I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the Lord.” So we are the bride of the lamb.

“And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the Lord, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth; And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.”

Everything answers in order in that day, right down to Jezreel — the name of the firstborn in chapter 1, the one whose day shall be great.

“And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy.” That's only on the Israelites.

“And I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.”

So with that, brothers: 12 tribes. 12 tribes. 12 tribes.
